column1: # class <TAB> retry <TAB> extended-regex <TAB> what it means / what to do
# TSV rather than YAML on purpose: instance-side bash greps this file directly
# with no parser, and RCC-side python reads the same file. One source, two
# `retry` is what a retry of the SAME command on the SAME hardware would do:
#   same     -- transient; retrying as-is is reasonable
#   other    -- deterministic here, may pass on different hardware (bigger GPU)
#   never    -- retrying cannot help; something must change first
#   unknown  -- not classified; escalate, never auto-act
# THIS FILE IS MEANT TO GROW. Every failure diagnosed once should be appended,
# which is the whole point: the system's coverage increases monotonically
# instead of each diagnosis being re-derived and forgotten.
# Order matters: first match wins, so put specific patterns above general ones.

column3: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|Out of memory allocating|CUDA out of memory|OutOfMemoryError|cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
column4: GPU ran out of VRAM. Retrying on the same card will fail again. Move the affected cells to a larger GPU, or reduce memory fraction (a knob change: your call, and it must apply to every cell in the arm or comparability breaks).

column3: No space left on device|ENOSPC|Disk quota exceeded
column4: Filesystem full. Checkpoints written during this period may be truncated but look complete -- verify realized counters before trusting any run from this window, not just the failed one.

column3: no done ckpt under|no donor checkpoint dir|ERROR: no done checkpoint under
column4: A required input checkpoint is absent. Either the donor wave never finished or the donor sync missed it. Check the donor with dv3ops check, then push-donors again.
Controlled replay was synced as a side dir without its parent manifest.json. axis1.sbatch requires it. Re-run push-donors: the spec declares the manifest as an input.

column3: ModuleNotFoundError|MISSING adapter deps|ImportError: cannot import name
column4: A python dependency is missing from the env this task ran in. For TD-MPC2 tasks a bare `python` means the Dreamer env, not TM2_CONDA_ENV -- check the interpreter before installing anything.

column3: Could not override|key .* is not in struct|ConfigAttributeError
column4: Hydra config key error. An existing key takes `key=value`; only a genuinely new key takes `+key=value`. (wandb.enabled exists: no plus.)

column3: CUDA error|no CUDA-capable device|CUDA driver version is insufficient|Failed to initialize NVML
column4: Driver or device fault. Often transient after a reset, but a repeat on the same instance means the host is sick -- prefer re-renting over fighting it.

column3: rsync: connection unexpectedly closed|/usr/bin/rsync: Permission denied
column4: The REMOTE rsync binary is broken (seen 2026-08-13: a 0-byte non-executable stub after a full disk). The sender-side message is misleading. Reinstall rsync on the instance.
Host OOM-killer took the process (system RAM, not VRAM). Reduce concurrent tasks per instance or move to a box with more RAM.

column3: DUE TO TIME LIMIT|CANCELLED AT .* DUE TO TIME
column4: Slurm walltime exceeded. Raise --time (36h max on RCC) or split the work; the partial checkpoint is resumable but verify realized steps.

column3: loss is NaN|nan in loss|Invalid loss
column4: Training diverged. Not an ops failure: retrying reproduces it. Needs a look at the run, not a requeue.
